# PEN-4515 - mark the unconditional `billingType: "api"` literal as deliberately not-fixed-here

Tracking: [PEN-4515](https://paperclip.blockcast.net/PEN/issues/PEN-4515)

Recorded here rather than in `PROVENANCE-CHANGES.md`: that file is frozen (BLO-34872) because
concurrent appends to it conflict on GitHub's server-side merge and get ejected from the merge
queue.

## 1. Comment-only change

**Files:** `src/server/execute.ts`

Comment only - no behaviour change in this adapter.

`execute.ts` returns one unconditional `billingType: "api"` for every run. That is false for
every live lane: all 11 production agents reach Anthropic through Penstock
(`ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL=https://api.penstock.run/anthropic`, authenticated with a 47-char `psk_`
Penstock key sourced from the `paperclip-penstock-org-key` secret on both production tiers), so
nothing here is metered per-token by Anthropic. The ledger consequently booked 100% of fleet
spend as `metered_api`.

It is NOT corrected here, and the comment says why at the line someone would reach for first.
This adapter cannot classify: the `ANTHROPIC_BASE_URL` that determines the lane is supplied by
the Job pod's image (`$HOME/.bashrc`, see `job-manifest.ts`), not by anything this process
holds. Nine of the eleven live lanes run through this adapter, so an adapter-local fix is
structurally unavailable for most of the fleet. Classification moved to
`server/src/services/billing-classification.ts`, which resolves the lane from the server's own
env - the same resolution `penstock-availability-gate.ts` already performs before every run,
measured live on the ledger-writing tier - and rewrites this value for brokered lanes.

The comment is worth its diff because the obvious edit here is actively dangerous: changing the
literal to `"subscription"` maps to `subscription_included`, the one value
`normalizeBilledCostCents` zeroes, which would take every budget cap in the fleet to $0 while
every dashboard still read healthy. That is precisely the failure the PEN-4463 ruling was filed
to prevent.

`vendor/paperclip-adapter-opencode-k8s/src/server/execute.ts` carries the same defect shape
(`billingType: fallbackCost !== null ? "metered_api" : "unknown"`) and is deliberately left
untouched rather than mirrored: the server-side classifier corrects it identically, so there is
no control to keep in sync here - only a comment, and the hazard it warns about (a hardcoded
`"api"` inviting a hardcoded `"subscription"`) does not exist in that file.
